claim_ceiling: Retires only the unusable full-report clipboard action after successful iPhone ZIP handoff proof. ZIP export, per-section copy, Whole App Health copy, diagnostics truth, owner/helper authority, routes, Bank, Continuous Run, storage, and persisted user data are unchanged. Fresh iPhone post-deployment confirmation is still required.

diagnostic_matrix_update.rationale: The already-proven iPhone ZIP handoff makes the complete-report clipboard action redundant and unusable. The permanent browser matrix now requires the full-report Copy control to be absent while the ZIP export, persistent direct-download path, all eight section-copy controls, complete report contents, and read-only boundaries remain intact.

observed_facts.fact: A fresh iPhone export produced the complete four-member Full Diagnostics ZIP with COMPLETE evidence and zero Whole App Health failures, warnings, or not-proven items before the clipboard control was retired.

The bounded implementation removes only the complete-report clipboard control and handler; ZIP export, persistent download, per-section copy, Whole App Health copy, and fullDiagnosticReport truth generation remain present and browser-certified.

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: Retiring the unusable complete-report clipboard action does not reduce diagnostic evidence availability because the proven ZIP handoff carries the complete report and the smaller section and Whole App Health copy controls remain available.
